statement: Viking Therapeutics registers a Phase 3 trial of oral VK2735 on ClinicalTrials.gov, or publicly announces initiation of oral VK2735 Phase 3 dosing, on or before 2026-12-31.
source_class: public registry and issuer press releases
method: frx-cal-v0 (registered, hash-committed; register scoring is the method's validation)
resolution_criterion: A ClinicalTrials.gov record with study phase Phase 3 and an oral VK2735 arm, first-posted on or before 2026-12-31, OR an issuer press release dated on or before 2026-12-31 announcing oral Phase 3 initiation. Either alone resolves correct; neither by the deadline resolves incorrect.
